title: Add Apple Pay support
body: Product wants Apple Pay at checkout in Q4. Needs gateway tokenization support.

title: Receipt shows total of 0.30000000000000004
body: Customer emailed a screenshot: two add-ons at 0.10 and 0.20, receipt total 0.30000000000000004. Finance also sees reconciliation mismatches since this morning.

title: Docs: API reference doesn't list supported currencies
body: api-reference.md should list currencies and their minor units.

title: Everyone keeps getting logged out
body: Since about 10:00 every request after login returns 401. Happens on web and mobile, all regions.

title: Customer charged twice for one order
body: Order ord_48213 has two charges 2 seconds apart with the same idempotency key. Support has 11 similar tickets since this afternoon. Is this INC-009 again?

title: Refunds made in the gateway dashboard don't show up
body: Refunds issued from the gateway dashboard never update the order in PayStream. Gateway shows our webhook endpoint returning 500 for those events.

title: Flaky test_gateway on CI
body: test_retries_until_success timed out once on CI. Could not reproduce; closing.

title: Checkout failing with gateway errors
body: Lots of 502s at checkout since early afternoon. Gateway status page is green. Their support says we're being rate limited.

title: All payments failing after v1.4.6
body: POST /payments returns 500 on every request since the v1.4.6 rollout. Orders and health check are fine.

title: Support console user search times out
body: Searching users by name takes 5-10 s and often times out since this morning. No import is running.

title: Payment API returning 500s after today's deploy
body: POST /payments has been failing intermittently since the v1.4.8 rollout around 14:20. Requests hang for about 5 seconds then return 500. Other endpoints look fine.
